assessor.name: independent AI reviewer
assessor.relationship: A separate AI review agent from the product implementation agent, in an AgentCAD-requested evaluation. This is not external third-party certification.
assessor.actions: Read pinned source and recorded results; independently ran headless counterexamples/targeted tests and inspected drawing images. Did not launch AutoCAD, FreeCAD or Claude and did not modify product source.

method.shared_scope: The same useful declared capabilities, implementation evidence and cumulative anchors apply to both fixed sources. No points for tool/test counts; no requirement for every industry feature or formal certification; optional features absent from the shared evaluated contract do not automatically lose points.
method.serious_defect_rule: A demonstrated serious false-success, destructive-write or permission defect caps its responsible item at 2 until fixed and retested. The same primary defect is not mechanically deducted in multiple items.
method.evidence_rule: Skips are not passes. Historical runs count only after tracing the relevant product-code boundary. Evidence of an earlier release is not silently relabeled as an exact-current result.
method.v8_rule: 31/31 is a separate execution result and is not converted into 100 source-review points.
method.meaning_of_score: A sum of bounded ordinal evidence judgments under this rubric. 98/100 is not a claim of 98% of all AutoCAD functionality, universal correctness or manufacturing certification.

publication_boundary.scope: Two pinned products under this local rubric only.
publication_boundary.warning: Do not combine these local scores with historical upstream self-review rows to claim an official #1 or a precise cross-review score improvement.

historical_upstream_review.type: upstream self-review; different historical version and scoring detail
historical_upstream_review.comparability: Preserved separately. It is not the local re-evaluation below.

consistency_notes: The provisional Pro E1 deduction for extra empty feature tables was removed at final common-scope review. A product is not penalized merely for exposing additional honest refusals that the other product does not offer. The previous provisional file is retained for audit.

AgentCAD E1 loses one point for an offered, emitted counterbore value whose standard reference remains unverified. AgentCAD E2 loses one point for missing critical annotations of already-specified model geometry in the actual production template.
The previously demonstrated AgentCAD ARC false connectivity and block-dimension precision bypass were fixed and rechecked at b4c0466. The temporary C2/E3 caps no longer apply.
Pro native source 13499fe888120ed929cc0c3b0afe303b1de83a74 remains applicable: its two subsequent commits to the fixed source only changed docs/results/tests, not the relevant product boundary.

Pro's published performance head efd33d0da26c7e44ac43413c0d2a1f7a36e8fba8 predates 17 subsequent commits affecting relevant source. It is credited as a version-comparison mechanism, not an exact-final performance rerun.
The Pro floating-dependency failure is a recorded ezdxf-version provenance assertion, not a demonstrated geometry regression.

native_showcase.pdf_boundary: The inspected mechanical PDF is headless PDF output from a DXF that was saved, reopened and activated by real AutoCAD. It is not a native AutoCAD PDF plot.

version_performance.scope: Direct Runtime, 2D lines only; includes saved validation and DXF roundtrip; no native CAD, MCP or model latency
version_performance.meaning: A same-machine version check with saved-output correctness assertions, not a cross-product timing race or a large-speedup claim.

pro.native_source_applicability: The two subsequent commits to the pinned product changed documentation, results and test-extra skips, with no relevant product-source change.
pro.native_environment: Published upstream AutoCAD 2026 / Windows / Python 3.13.15 records; not a new native run by this reviewer.

floating_dependencies.reason: Published-report ezdxf 1.4.4 provenance assertion versus floating installation 1.4.5.
floating_dependencies.interpretation: Not counted as a demonstrated geometry/behavior regression.

review_limitations: The product implementation and most native run records were produced by their respective projects. This reviewer inspected source, output records, images and provenance, and independently ran the stated headless checks; it did not independently execute either native CAD application.
This is a source-and-evidence assessment of fixed revisions, not a controlled shared-host native or model/agent comparison.
A higher total under these local anchors supports only this two-product local assessment. It does not establish an upstream-approved or worldwide leaderboard position.

Both products retain explicitly bounded engineering, drawing and security behavior. Items at 5 mean the required evidence level was met within that useful contract, not that every CAD feature is implemented or every future input is correct.

audit_history.note: Drafts and failed original counterexamples are retained. Only assessment.json is the final scorecard.
